observations: Large flat-screen TV photographed outdoors, leaning on a cardboard box and against a car.
Box edge visible reads something like 'TV 75"'.
Screen bezel/logo area shows text reading 'SAVOX' and 'Google TV' logo, not a Samsung logo.
Screen is off/dark; no power-on state, no visible picture, no serial or model plate visible.
Photo is blurry, taken at an angle, with a person's shadow and legs reflected in the screen.

identity.brand: SAVOX (as read from photo, not Samsung as claimed)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'SAVOX' and 'Google TV' branding on the screen, not Samsung.

claims.claim: It has a power fault only
claims.evidence: Screen is off in the photo; no way to confirm power fault is the only issue or that the panel, backlight, and board are otherwise fine.
No weatherproofing marks, IP rating, or outdoor housing visible in photo.

risks.risk: Brand misrepresentation: seller says Samsung but visible branding reads SAVOX, a different (likely lower-value) brand.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the brand logo and model/serial sticker on the back of the TV.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the unverified/lesser brand (SAVOX), not as Samsung

risks.risk: Extent of 'power fault' unknown — could be simple PSU board, or could involve mainboard/backlight failure, drastically changing repair cost.
risks.proof: Video of seller attempting to power it on, showing symptoms (no light, clicking, blinking standby light, etc.)
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working unit, worst-case repair cost assumed

risks.risk: Screen/panel condition cannot be verified since unit is off — cracks, dead pixels, or water damage from 'outdoor' use not visible.
risks.proof: Photo of screen powered on, and close-up photos of panel surface in daylight without glare.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, assume possible panel damage

risks.risk: No model number visible to confirm exact size/specs (e.g. true 75" panel, resolution, smart TV platform).
risks.proof: Photo of the rear label with model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base-tier 75" smart TV specs only

risks.risk: Outdoor-rated claim unverified — ordinary indoor TVs exposed outdoors can have hidden moisture/corrosion damage.
risks.proof: Photos of the back casing, ports, and any IP-rating label.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard indoor TV with possible environmental damage risk

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rear label showing brand, model number, and serial number.
Video of the seller plugging in the TV and showing the exact power fault symptom.
Close-up photos of the screen panel in daylight (powered off) to check for cracks or pressure marks.
Photo of any IP rating or outdoor certification label, if claimed as outdoor-rated.
Photo of remote control and accessories included.
response.reason: The photo shows 'SAVOX' branding on the screen, directly contradicting the seller's claim of a Samsung TV, which is a material misrepresentation affecting price and trust.
